evidence.note: Recomputed SHA256 of the three vendored JS files at the exact /app/static/ paths, caught that alpine downloaded as cdn.min.js, renamed and re-verified hashes — directly mirroring the hash-pin gate.
Ran the server and exercised /_health, /api/v1/instance, /public, /@seeduser, /tags, /api/v1/trends, and an OAuth password-grant token — verifying core flows beyond 'it boots'.

Comprehensive smoke test: OAuth token, posting a status, CSP header inspection (noticed unsafe-inline for style-src), 404 handler, authenticated timeline, follow/unfollow, and cookie security (HttpOnly/SameSite) checks.
Explicitly verified seed minimums (9 accounts, 23 statuses, 36 hashtags, 2 CWs, 9 authors) against the task's seed-pool targets.

Final verification pass re-confirming vendored SHA256, no Node pipeline, /_health, start.sh — but PKCE, scope enforcement, restart-durability, and realism specifics (palette, button label, visibility icons) were never tested; the account.id bug and CSP unsafe-inline were still open, so loops weren't fully closed.

reasoning: The agent went well beyond level 5's 'main flows + spot-check': it recomputed the three hash pins at exact paths, inspected CSP/security headers, checked cookie HttpOnly/SameSite, exercised OAuth token issuance and posting, and verified seed-count minimums — several of the knowable verifier checks. But it fell short of level 8's systematic coverage: no PKCE flow, no scope-enforcement test, no restart-durability check, and no realism-specific verification (palette, button label, visibility icons), and it submitted with known bugs (account.id, CSP unsafe-inline) unresolved. This targeted-but-incomplete, not-fully-closed verification sits between the 5 and 8 anchors, at 6.
